$description: UberTib density. Density is a property of the ARCHETYPE and the profile, not of the platform. The obvious split - patient spacious, panels compact - is wrong, and the confirmed usage contexts say why: PO-UX-07 records the clinic representative and invited staff as desktop and tablet users with a high interruption rate, and a person working while being interrupted wants targets they can hit without looking, not a maximally dense grid. The two genuinely dense surfaces in this product are the five Clinic workspace screens, where density is earned by repeated structured entry.

reading.$description: All 47 Patient screens, every archetype. An episodic actor who will never become fluent, on one reading column, on a phone, in a variable environment, at any supported text size.

space-scale.$description: The baseline the semantic space tokens are authored at.

target-floor.$description: Patient primary actions never fall below this.

operational.$description: Profile A default - detail, form, list-and-detail and dashboard archetypes. Trained but interrupted: comfortable targets, stable positions, no ceremony on a frequent task and full ceremony on an irreversible one.

dense.$description: The Profile A workspace archetype - five screens - and table BODIES inside list-and-detail, nothing else. Density is earned by repeated structured entry; it is not granted by being a panel.

target-floor.$description: A control may render at control-sm here, but its HIT AREA is expanded to reach this floor. A 32px control with a 32px hit area is a defect.

rule.$description: How a density mode resolves, and the two floors it may never cross.

applies-to.$description: The multiplier applies to layout spacing only - insets, stacks, inline gaps and gutters.

never-applies-to.$value: fontSize, lineHeight, size.target-floor, size.target-primary, focus.*, borderWidth.*
never-applies-to.$description: Density compresses the space around content; it never shrinks the glyph, the focus ring or the touch target. A dense table has tighter rows and the same 14px Arabic text as everywhere else.

rounding.$description: A multiplied value rounds to the nearest 2px and never resolves below the 2px hairline step, so density can never collapse a gap to zero.

floor-target.$description: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8. No mode, on any platform, renders an interactive target below this once the hit area is counted.

floor-patient-primary.$description: Every Patient primary action, and every deadline-bearing action on any platform, whatever the mode.
